data.why: The app takes only a typed PDB ID (prefilled with 6tlj as an example) and fetches all sequence/mapping data live from the PDBe and UniProt REST APIs; there is no file upload and no bundled dataset to seed.

goals: Retrieve the curated SIFTS UniProt-to-PDB chain mapping for a structure and export it as DBREF records
Derive an automated UniProt mapping by sequence search and local alignment when no curated SIFTS mapping exists
Cross-check a curated SIFTS mapping against an independently computed automated alignment for the same entry
Batch-process multiple PDB IDs at once and download a single combined DBREF file
Identify chains/entities that fail to map (point mutations, fusion tags, missing source organism) and inspect the mapping details/warnings for each

review.summary: The tree describes the curated SIFTS → DBREF workflow well: batch entry, export layouts and the per-chain quality table are all there, and the screens I opened match their nodes. It needs fixes before filing: the automated phase records a temporary UniProt outage as how the app behaves (the replay check mapped 3A1Y successfully), the curated-vs-automated comparison and unmatched-chain diagnosis are missing, and Merge segments is described the opposite way from the README and code.
